content.long:
District heating fieldnote — shared demand

At 07:00, most buildings request heat together. Compare preheating, insulation, and a slower morning ramp. Keep the existing comfort standard while checking which homes benefit.

城市供热观察：清晨的需求同时上升。应比较保温、提前供热和分时调节，并记录室内舒适度。不要把平均值当作所有家庭的体验。

Evidence to collect: hourly demand, indoor temperature, and resident feedback. Open question: can the change reduce the peak without moving discomfort to older buildings?

下一步：记录两周数据，复查极冷天气，并询问住户。

note.value:
District heating fieldnote — shared demand

At 07:00, most buildings request heat together. Compare preheating, insulation, and a slower morning ramp. Keep the existing comfort standard while checking which homes benefit.

states.label: 00-empty

note.value:
District heating fieldnote — shared demand

At 07:00, most buildings request heat together. Compare preheating, insulation, and a slower morning ramp. Keep the existing comfort standard while checking which homes benefit.

城市供热观察：清晨的需求同时上升。应比较保温、提前供热和分时调节，并记录室内舒适度。不要把平均值当作所有家庭的体验。

Evidence to collect: hourly demand, indoor temperature, and resident feedback. Open question: can the change reduce the peak without moving discomfort to older buildings?

下一步：记录两周数据，复查极冷天气，并询问住户。

At 07:00, most buildings request heat together. Compare preheating, insulation, and a slower morning ramp. Keep the existing comfort standard while checking which homes benefit.

城市供热观察：清晨的需求同时上升。应比较保温、提前供热和分时调节，并记录室内舒适度。不要把平均值当作所有家庭的体验。

Evidence to collect: hourly demand, indoor temperature, and resident feedback. Open question: can the change reduce the peak without moving discomfort to older buildings?

下一步：记录两周数据，复查极冷天气，并询问住户。Saved in this browser
